release candidate opens a usable research-to-results start screen
phone navigation exposes each workspace with a readable touch control

original PDF page can be inspected instead of trusting extraction alone
saved HTML becomes readable text without scripts or remote resource requests
reimporting a document reuses its page citations
three editable openings start as drafts without mutating the source plan
unreviewed campaign cannot obtain a reviewed render package
local visual audio and evidence bindings pass production checks
approval binds the exact script source and asset hashes
production package captions and source-linked test card export
actual downloaded portrait video decodes with audio and planned duration
the actual exported video enters our draft library idempotently without invented analytics
cancelled render creates no completion receipt
three opening variants render sequentially as visibly marked drafts
changed source invalidates previous review before another final export
backup restores campaigns but never restores approval as fresh authority
factory editor fits a phone-width viewport
diagnostics report capabilities without leaking source titles or prompts
portable project pack includes original media documents and historical exports
incomplete upload leftovers are disclosed and do not break project packs
changed archive bytes are rejected before any library write
failed IndexedDB media write aborts the entire restore transaction
cancelled restore creates no new library revision
project pack restore commits metadata and media together while clearing old approval
restored document originals remain inspectable
offline installation retains a hash-matched app cache and excludes private API data
project library and original PDF reading survive a full offline restart
no uncaught browser exceptions
rendering does not upload footage or call external services

open_acceptance.title: Measured generative reasoning and video semantics
open_acceptance.acceptance: Explicitly enabled model, actual inference, representative labelled evaluation and error analysis. Runtime loading alone is not inference.

open_acceptance.title: Physical iPhone/Safari qualification
open_acceptance.acceptance: Install, import, background/reconnect, render and play exported media on a physical supported iPhone.

open_acceptance.title: Authorised social-account intake
open_acceptance.acceptance: Separately authorised platform connections with platform permission/policy checks and real retrieval receipts.

open_acceptance.title: Cross-device synchronisation
open_acceptance.acceptance: Real authenticated sync, conflict/recovery and privacy checks. Explicit project-pack transfer is not live sync.

open_acceptance.title: Real-world cohort and campaign validation
open_acceptance.acceptance: Ordinary and weak posts included, held-out evaluation and measured prospective own-post outcomes; no guarantee of viral reach.

boundaries: No actual local language-model inference, no new model download or installer.
No physical iPhone or Safari export acceptance.
No social-account credential or connector, automatic publishing or live sync.
Tests use generated media/documents and isolated Chrome profiles on the Windows build host.
Public article requests validate retrieval and coverage, not correctness of their arguments.
The stable Windows executable and private canonical native renderer remain unchanged.
